cohort: The cohort consisted of 470 children (53% boys) born between August 2009 and March 2011 at the University Hospital of Patras, Greece.
finding: Male sex was an overall predisposing factor for preschool wheezing, and girls born by caesarean section developed wheezing more frequently than their vaginally born counterparts.
mod_finding: In girls, the development of wheezing was significantly associated with caesarean section (OR: 2.48, 95% CI: 1.28-4.83, p = 0.007), whereas this association was not significant in boys.
